name: ECONSTAT prelim-vs-final settlement flips

gate.advance_requires: flip rate on near-boundary strikes >= 5% AND no flip discount in last-trade prices (fade edge >= 2c/ct net, release-clustered CI excluding zero)
gate.result: fails at step 3 (flip count); price test moot

bucket: not a settlement mechanic - the mechanism does not exist. The only surviving trade is forecasting the revision, which belongs in the 0-for-6 'we have better information' bucket.

qualifying_set.definition: series whose <econ stat> is a labelled preliminary / flash / advance print

assumed_but_absent.sp_global_flash_pmi: NO flash PMI series exist on Kalshi. Sweep of 4106 series for 'PMI' returns KXISMPMI, KXISMSERVICES, KXUSISMSERV, KXCHNBSPMI, KXCAIVEYPMI - all single-print statistics with no preliminary.

missed_by_the_title_screen_but_checked.KXUSDURABLE: Census ADVANCE durable goods; settles on the advance, lag 1.06h
missed_by_the_title_screen_but_checked.KXUSRETAIL: Census ADVANCE monthly retail; settles on the advance, lag 1.01h

flip_study.clustering: by release event (all strikes in one release share the revision and are perfectly correlated)
flip_study.note: The statistical bound is secondary. The load-bearing result is structural: settlement print == the print the market closed on, by construction.

settlement_lag_diagnostic.meaning: a prelim->final gap requires a lag of days/weeks; a same-morning lag proves the market settled on the release it closed one minute before

natural_experiment.statistic: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment, June 2026

corroborating_settlements.source: Istat, Consumer prices - May 2026 (confirms the flash estimate)

liquidity.scope: traded settled markets in the 13 qualifying series, 1-min candles over the 6h pre-close window
liquidity.two_sided_rule: bid > 0 AND ask < 1.00 AND spread <= 0.25; post-halt candle (bid 0.00 / ask 1.00) always discarded

reusable_api_facts.settled_status_is_finalized_not_settled: status == 'settled' returns ZERO rows across all 197 series; the value is 'finalized'. Silent failure mode.
reusable_api_facts.settlement_ts_fractional_seconds: variable digit count (e.g. '.21184Z'); Python 3.9 fromisoformat accepts only 3 or 6 and silently dropped 164->144 events. Normaliser in econstat_research/settle_lag_census.py::iso
reusable_api_facts.candlesticks_endpoint: GET /series/{series}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks?start_ts&end_ts&period_interval=1 - per-minute bid/ask/volume/OI, reaches far past the ~1-month trade-history window
reusable_api_facts.post_close_candle_is_a_trap: book collapses to bid 0.00 / ask 1.00 on halt; must be dropped or it fabricates a 100c spread
reusable_api_facts.econstat_absent_from_kalshi_fees_table: src/kalshi_fees.py::_SERIES_MAKER_FEE has no ECONSTAT entry, so series_maker_charges_fee() falls through to conservative True; all 197 are actually quadratic (maker-free). Harmless for gating, wrong for sizing. NO CODE CHANGE MADE.

reopen_condition: Only if Kalshi lists a series whose rules_primary names an UNLABELLED statistic while close_time sits one minute before that statistic's FLASH release - i.e. settlement_ts - close_time running into days. The settlement-lag diagnostic detects this in one field.

constraints_observed.git_operations: none - files left on disk for the orchestrating session to commit
